chunks: Zurārah and Fuḍayl narrated from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
"The ghusl in the month of Ramaḍān is at the setting of the sun, shortly before it; then he performs salat (prayer) and breaks the fast."

key_terms.الْغُسْلُ: ritual bath to be performed at the stated time
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of fasting in which this ruling applies
key_terms.وُجُوبِ الشَّمْسِ: the setting or disappearance of the sun at sunset

ai.seo_question: When should ghusl be performed in Ramaḍān before ifṭār?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a ruling about the timing of ghusl in the month of Ramaḍān, indicating that it is done near sunset, shortly before it. It also outlines the sequence that follows: one performs salat (prayer) and then breaks the fast.
